methodology.positions: All positions recomputed by frozen supervision.forward_kinematics in CPU float32, then float64 differences/norms. Root correction=2*delta motion[:3]; rest cancels. World up=y.
methodology.velocity: first difference *30; acceleration=second difference*900; norms in stated units
methodology.GT_low_speed_mask: GT 3D joint velocity norm <0.2m/s, per foot and consecutive frame
methodology.delta: full-learned_only final generated sequences; includes all downstream DDIM feedback after physical intervention, NOT isolated last guide correction
methodology.root_relative_foot_delta: foot_position_delta - root_translation_delta. Vector decomposition exact; their norm magnitudes do not add.
methodology.rotation: each local 6D decoded/orthogonalized. D_t=R_full,t R_learned,t^T; correction step=geodesic(D_t D_t-1^T). Root joint=0.
methodology.spectrum: fraction of demeaned final foot position correction rFFT power at frequencies >=3Hz; descriptive only, not a quality threshold.
methodology.aggregation: recording-equal within each dataset and equal dataset macro; balanced panel means equivalent to equal windows within regime. clean/noisy share recordings and are not independent recordings.
methodology.energy: before/after compare within each guide call with its FIXED evidence. Summing calls is diagnostic only; not a single trajectory-wide energy guarantee.
methodology.saved_data_limit: no per-frame solver correspondence/contact weights, energy components or accepted backtracking fractions were saved, so exact source of temporal changes cannot be attributed from these arrays.
methodology.final_difference_is_not_raw_solver_delta: The full-minus-learned_only arrays are final outputs after DDIM20. They include changed later noisy states, learned proposals, contact predictions and scene re-queries. Do not label these as raw physical solver updates for any single call.

config.acceptance: joint physical/observation/prior energy decreases and trusted measurements protected
config.placement: every clean x0 before next DDIM update; shallow observed support only

code_evidence.finding: Per-frame proximity/normal/contact threshold gates and nearest anchor/surface choices; slip not active at every foot/frame.
Weighted scalar energy includes contact/plane/slip/observation/prior/correction-first-difference; no final-motion acceleration or joint angular smoothness objective.
Slip applies only continuous contact-weighted anchors with valid surface velocities and equal owners, with 0.2m/s dead zone; configured total weight=0.02.
Temporal term penalizes change of Cartesian correction, not output acceleration; scalar total decline permits individual components to worsen.

Framewise translation and per-frame/joint rotation gradients are norm clipped; one shared backtracking fraction per whole window. Accept total energy drop, protected observation positional error tolerance and max root limit only.
Evidence/contact weights rebuilt from current base each denoising call; fixed for its two optimizer iterations, not frozen across DDIM trajectory.
Each candidate is passed again through confidence anchor and position proximal IK before acceptance; preserving head position can redistribute articulated/root corrections.
Physical correction applied within every eligible x0, thus changes later DDIM and learned query paths.

At the first optimizer iteration, prior and correction temporal energies have zero gradient at correction=0. Their nonzero candidate penalties still affect the scalar acceptance test; two iterations do not solve a globally smooth constrained trajectory.

inferences_not_proven: Hard/nearest evidence changes and framewise clipping are plausible mechanisms for temporal roughness; saved outputs do not log the corresponding switches, so causation at a particular frame is unproven.
Root versus root-relative foot deltas show how final sequence changes, but cannot isolate solver joint gradients from subsequent learned DDIM propagation.
Energy-component tradeoff cannot be measured because only total energies were saved; objective code establishes it is allowed.
